parts.name: TPD4E1B06 (Texas Instruments)
parts.placement_notes: Added on the advisor's recommendation: the electrode leads are the only conductors leaving the sealed shell and touching a person, so they are the ESD entry path.

parts.name: ADS1292R (Texas Instruments)
parts.placement_notes: 24-bit front end on a ~1 mV biopotential. 15 mm from switching sources because the buck's fundamental and harmonics land inside its 0-150 Hz measurement band; 10 mm from heat because package self-heating drifts the input offset and reads as baseline wander.

parts.name: MDBT42Q-512KV2 (Raytac)

_dimension_source.length: MDBT42Q Approval Sheet Version P (2025/07/14), p.6, nominal
_dimension_source.width: MDBT42Q Approval Sheet Version P (2025/07/14), p.6, nominal
_dimension_source.height: MDBT42Q Approval Sheet Version P (2025/07/14), p.6, nominal

parts.placement_notes: Module with an integrated antenna, so it is both the radio and a digital noise source. The 6 mm keep-out is the ground-plane clearance the module's integration guide requires ahead of the antenna end; it is a mission-level assumption, not a catalog measurement, because the catalog records no keep-out geometry.

parts.name: TPS62740 (Texas Instruments)
parts.placement_notes: The switching node is the dominant conducted-noise source on the board. The 6 mm thermal radius is a geometric proxy scaled to a 3x2 mm package on modest copper, not a solved field.

parts.name: BQ24040 (Texas Instruments)
parts.placement_notes: Linear charger: its dominant emission is heat, and worst case is the precondition-to-constant-current transition, not steady state. Chosen over mcp73831 on the advisor's recommendation because it has a thermal pad and a TS pin for a cell thermistor.
